hints.en: You need two numbers: the year she enrolled, and how long the programme runs.
hints.hr: Trebaju ti dva broja: godina upisa i koliko traje program.

hints.en: Her enrollment year is on the class timetable in her room; a Croatian gimnazija runs four years.
hints.hr: Godina upisa je na razrednom rasporedu u njezinoj sobi; hrvatska gimnazija traje četiri godine.
